text:
Sara (CEO): Quick update before EOD — three things to call out and two asks.
Sara (CEO): 1) APAC private beta: tentative rollout next Thu 02:00 UTC (region windows). Priya + Marcus please confirm infra readiness by Tue.
Sara (CEO): 2) Policy tweak: default audit-log retention remains 90d but customers will see a clearer opt-in flow for extended retention. Lina to publish the short FAQ.
Sara (CEO): 3) Incident note: morning cache corruption caused elevated p50 for ~12m for a single shard; auto-failover worked but some customers saw higher tail. Omar will post a short postmortem.
Sara (CEO): Metrics snapshot: hosted p95 = 110ms (improved), errors 0.45% (close to target), Dedicated throughput unchanged. Hiring: two infra hires approved this week.
Sara (CEO): Asks: (A) Clara please draft a 1-paragraph customer note on APAC beta + retention change by Tue 9am. (B) Marcus/Omar please lock the KV repair playbook and share runbook link.

Marcus (VP Eng): Ack. APAC nodes queued; we still need a final kernel/quantization check on the M60 fleet. Will run tests Mon morning and tag @Priya.
Marcus (VP Eng): Regarding KV repair, Omar and I added a `kv-repair.md` runbook to the infra repo. Brief snippet:
```
# kv-repair run snippet
1. Mark shard read-only
2. Run `kv-validate --shard X`
3. Rehydrate from secondary
```

Lina (Head Legal): I'll post the retention FAQ and update the privacy page. We'll use simple Q&A, and note enterprise opt-in flow.

Omar (SRE): Incident quick note: root cause = rare bitmap corruption on the cache bucket; auto-detect threshold increased. Full postmortem tomorrow. Temp mitigation applied (checksum verification added).
Omar (SRE): Commands we ran:
```
kubectl exec -it cache-pod-3 -- /bin/bash -c "kv-checksum --fix"
systemctl restart infer-cache
```

Priya (Product): Working on APAC messaging and feature flags. We should gate extended retention behind an agreement toggle for enterprise customers.

Raj (Finance): Small ask: for APAC beta, please share expected qtr spend delta so we can evaluate burn and billing mapping.

Clara (Comms): On it — will draft customer note and a short internal FAQ. Expect first draft by Mon noon.

deploy-bot: deployment queued for `private-apac-beta` by @Marcus (commit def456)  ETA ~35m.

Sara (CEO): Thanks team. Will add a 1-slide summary to Monday all-hands; flag me directly if APAC tests fail or legal needs more time. :sparkles:
